name: Pay a registered bill payee from a member's account
description:
Look up the member by member number, open their profile, and click 'Pay a Bill'. Select the given account_no from the From Account dropdown by its exact account number, select the given payee_id from the Payee dropdown (match it to whichever option corresponds to that payee), enter the amount, and submit the payment. Read back the confirmation reference shown after submission.

Returns: confirmation_ref — Confirmation reference shown after the payment is submitted.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, insufficient_funds.
